text:
Assistant B correctly fulfills the request: it provides a complete HTML page with a button that, when clicked, displays a random joke from a list of exactly 4 jokes. The joke is shown on the page in a `div`, and the random selection logic is correct.

Assistant A does not meet the requirements: the button has no matching `id`, so the event listener will fail; the joke is only logged to the console instead of being shown on the page; the list contains 6 strings rather than 4 jokes; and the selection is not random.

[[B]]
